JOB DESCRIPTION

We have requirement for 1 Senior Data Scientist / AI-ML Engineer and are looking for candidates with 6+ years of relevant experience

Base Compensation Range: 100,000 - 140,000

The posted range is the hiring range for this role — a subset of the broader range available to employees over time — and reflects base salary across our national hiring scale. Final offers are based on several factors, including the candidate's skills and experience, internal pay equity, work location, market conditions for the role, and the specific scope and responsibilities of the position. The top of the range is reserved for candidates who notably exceed the requirements; the lower end applies to those with less experience or fewer preferred qualifications. For positions based in higher-cost zones (e.g., California, New York, New Jersey), actual compensation may exceed the posted range; your recruiter will share specifics during the process.

For more information on benefits and what we offer please visit us at https://www.exlservice.com/us-careers-and-benefits

RESPONSIBILITIES

Key Requirements

Strong hands-on expertise in AI/ML, Data Science, Python, SQL, and Git/GitHub.
Proven experience building end-to-end data science and predictive modeling solutions, from problem definition through deployment.
Strong understanding of Property & Casualty (P&C) Insurance business processes.
Ability to translate complex business challenges into practical AI/ML and analytical solutions.
Strong focus on business outcomes and measurable impact, beyond model development.
Experience applying AI/ML solutions in areas such as: 
Pricing
Risk Segmentation
Underwriting Decision Support
Forecasting
Operational Optimization
Strong GitHub and software engineering practices including: 
Version Control
Code Reviews
Documentation
Testing
Reusable Code Development
Excellent communication skills with the ability to present technical concepts to business and non-technical stakeholders.
Ability to work as a senior independent contributor, driving initiatives end-to-end with minimal support.
Experience leading: 
Business Discovery
Data Assessment
Model Development & Validation
Deployment

User Adoption

QUALIFICATIONS

Bachelor's in Computer science, engineering or any related field
